cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Complete the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to fill the missing gaps in an account without revealing which answer matters most to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm completing the shared car log. Give me mileage, fuel and who drove after nine. I'll take them in that order.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can raise that once the row is complete. Start with mileage; the other columns aren't decoration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Driver I remember. The rest means going down six flights to the glovebox.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fetch the book. You stay here and put the kettle on; we'll do the whole row over tea. Don't fill in the last column while I'm gone. I'll call each heading when we're ready.

reason: Turn B suspicion into a deferred request A controls and preserve the costly retrieval rather than take the convenient driver answer; make the shared tea practical cooperation with A retaining sequence.
